diffs.why: Environmental, not a data diff (R-DA; operator y 2026-10-19, replay night N1): the step's first stdout line prints the target's applied-migration count ("target: … migrations=<n> (floor …)"). It moves whenever a migration lands between the committed POST and its retake — N1 applied 266, 267, 268 and 273, so it reads migrations=264 where the committed POST read 260. The R-DK stability half compares every retaken POST with the committed one, so every migration night shows this line.

ONE-TIME, for the wf2/p4-integrate-4 merge commit only, removed in the follow-up commit straight after (operator y 2026-10-19, reusing the RE-FREEZE #37 approval). The merge base a17a3b60 still carries the parcel_abutments POST that hashed 10 columns, including the run-clock column linked_at (4a36b0f647c21368d2c567bb908de33a). #37 projects linked_at out (Spec 124 R-DA; R-DZ "goldens project it out or explain it"; the link_massing parcel_buildings.linked_at precedent), so the merged POST hashes the 9 value columns (448d1039…). The R-DK stability half compares against `git show HEAD:<file>`, so this diff shows until HEAD holds the merged POST. Row count unchanged at 1,674,346; every metric unchanged.
